notes.title: Update 10.0 (UPGRADE YOUR SUITS!)
notes.content:
-Now, an upgrade option menu is available when you finish a stage. The game notifies you when UPGRADES are 

possible, you can gain points from the COMPLETION RATING of each stage up to 100% per stage.

In specific you can upgrade the following things:

A) DAMAGE IN WEAPONS:
- Bat
- Gun
- Laser 
- Flame

B) IMPROVEMENT MECHANICS:
- Increase the Charge Rate of the LASER.
- Increase the threshold in which the FLAMETHROWER overheats.
- Damage reduction("Hysteria depletion") on the penalty you receive when you use Second Wind.
- Increase Total Damage when in Time-Dillation.

C) PROTECTION:
- Damage reduction

-Also added a minorine achievement.

FIXES:
-Fixed an issue with the Keyboard and Options UI of the MAIN MENU.
-Restored certain dialog lines

Edit:

-Upgrades are now accessible from the apartment.
-Fixed an issue with second wind on the boss stage of chapter 5.
-Adjusted design of Boss Stage Chapter 5 (original design is kept for HARDCORE mode).
-Explicit reference to how the WORK ORDERS work, when the boss fight of chapter 1 ends.

Edit 1/2/2017:
-Now Wormwood Studios logo is skippable with ESCAPE
-Also fixed initial loading time.

notes.title: Update 9.6 Chapter 8 Chapter 9 + Chapter 10
notes.content:
-Now slowmotion hurts less when you use it. (Normal Mode)
-Second Chance now hurts less when you use it. (Normal Mode)
-Adjusted duration on all the platforms that use hysteria on chapter 9, so that they stay more (Normal Mode)
-Now SWARM (the flying robots that cut your head off) now don't instakill you. They deal a lot of damage, but no more instakills.
-Now Chapter 10 enemies are properly frozen, cannot attack for 25% of the duration of the freeze and now also "animate" slower when under the effect. "Lion chargers" are less affected by the effect.

EDIT:
-Now holding jump will make jumps a bit bigger. (took a while to put that in, i'm a bit ashamed :D)

notes.title: Demo Announcement and Update V4.0
notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE v2.0 - No more one shot one kill
notes.content:
After some long consideration, and certain voices that have voiced their annoyance over this, even though nobody quite expressed it in a sense that I heard about this and refused to take action, instead it was a silent complaint, I've taken a forward step towards the addition of a new mechanic.

Basically till chapter Nine, where there is a healthbar, till then you have an armor. It kinda works like Ghouls N Goblins, except this one recharges on normal difficulty. Through the use of the shield. 

Obviously, falls will still mean death, however when you are hit by an enemy, when your shield is down or can't block said attack, you'll be able to survive the hit. The armor will discharge when it absorbs said hit. That means you need to either wait for about 20 seconds for it to charge on its own, or you can charge it in 2 by using your shield. And then you can take another shot to the face.

That way we make the shield more useful, since many of the players I've seen do ignore it, and you no longer die cause some enemy pulled a gun on you faster, even though now u can see them.

This instructional message will appear on Stage Two, Chapter One, which is the first stage in the game that has enemies.

[u]MESSAGE:[/u]

The exoskeleton's armor can prevent lethal damage, when it's fully charged
1) The armor will discharge when it succesfully absorbs damage.
2) It recharges on its own after a little while. 

Normal Difficulty:
3)You can speed this process by opening up the SHIELD

notes.title: General Fixes Update
notes.content:
I've had a big discussion with a user today, and from the overall experience, you guys and gals, have shared I've updated the game again, with the following fixes.

-Double B 

Added a functionality, which means that when playing with the joystick,
if you press double B (which is the back button), the first time it takes u to the respective back button, and the second time, it activates said back button and takes you out of the UI.

-POV Works for MENUS

POV seemed to work only with the game controls before, now it works also with all the menus/UIs.

-CONFIRM BUTTON MOUSE-OVER GRAPHICS

Adjusted the visibility of the mouse-over graphic for the Confirm and Cancel buttons that would appear once you started a new game.

-UI BUTTONS MOUSEOVER GRAPHICS

Adjusted the visibility of the mouse-over graphic for several buttons that would make it hard to discern before, now should be good and very visible where the selection is at.

-Twitching

Fixed a minor twitching glitch that would appear when u first go on the world map screen, from the MAIN MENU.

-Apartment on the MAIN MENU

Fixed an issue, where you could take ur selection on the Apartment, on the World Map Screen, thus making the selection disappear entirely, now, that is no longer possible.

notes.title: Another minor update.
notes.content:
So taking as much feedback as humanly possible, I've done another update, it's way more unimportant than the previous one, but towards the correct direction I believe.


*Bugfixes*

1) Fixed an issue that would rarely but still occur on Stage 1 Chapter 1 (both modes)


*Reduced difficulty factors regarding Normal Difficulty (Hard mode is unaffected)*


1) Bosses Ichi and Ori are now easier to beat.
   -Ichi's platforms move slower now
   -Ori takes less hits to kill
   -Ori bubble radius decreased a bit as well

The reasoning behind this is that most of the people give up on either of these bosses

3) Now, difficulty scaling, scales lesser for Normal Mode by 50%
4) Moving Bombs on Stage 2 Chapter 2, are now moving slower and thus make the level quite less annoying. And themselves as well.
5) Chapter Eight's Swarm is now disabled for twice the time as it was before, thus making it easier to handle, you're not supposed to allow it to spawn, but at least u can easily outrun it and finish the stage, and get that achievement.


Epilogue.

Honestly, if you think there are bullshit factors, please do report them, I want to make this game as potentially best as humanly possibly, I think the content is there, was always there, I just hope it's accessible.

As always progress will not be affected or deleted ever by any of the updates, so you're in good hands.
